description: A man in a fedora and dark trench coat stands on a dirt shoulder at a cliff edge, looking up. Beside him is a dark 1940s sedan on a winding coastal road with a guardrail. Above, a white Spanish-style mansion with a red tile roof sits on a hillside among palms, with the ocean and surf to the right. The painting is an oil-style scene with warm, hazy light and no visible text or frame.
